f1_eval_regression.display_name: [dev devuser] Formula 1 Analyst: RAG evaluation regression
f1_eval_regression.query_text:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT metric, score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM agent_factory_dev.${resources.schemas.agent_factory.name}.eval_results
  WHERE domain = 'f1' AND target = 'dev' AND metric LIKE 'rag_eval.%'
),
thresholds(metric, threshold) AS (VALUES ('rag_eval.correctness', 0.7), ('rag_eval.groundedness', 0.75))
SELECT MIN(latest.score - thresholds.threshold) AS margin
FROM thresholds
JOIN latest ON latest.metric = thresholds.metric AND latest.rn = 1
